newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hizbollah kills Israeli soldier in S.Lebanon - army.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah kills Israeli soldier in S.Lebanon - army.

text.p: Islamic guerrillas killed an Israeli soldier and wounded three others in a roadside blast in south Lebanon, the army said on Monday.

A tank on operational activity near Beit Yahoun in the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone set off the roadside charge late on Sunday, an army spokesman said. Army censors delayed publication of the report until Monday.
"The Hizbollah organisation claimed responsibility for the incident," he said.
One soldier was seriously hurt in the blast, dying in hospital later of his wounds. Three others suffered light to moderate injuries.
"The charge went off. The other soldiers and I were wounded. We were stuck in the tank and the evacuation took about two hours," one of the wounded soldiers told reporters from his hospital bed.
Israel set up the 15 km (nine mile) -wide zone in 1985 to protect its northern border against guerrilla attacks when it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 Lebanon invasion force.
Guerrilla groups, principally the Iranian-backed Hizbollah (Party of God) group, are fighting to oust Israel from the zone.
On Saturday, the Israeli army said guerrillas wounded one soldier in south Lebanon.
